title: NEXUS telemetry message (contract 1.0 and legacy-v1)
description: Device to NEXUS. Legacy shape: deviceId, timestamp, sensorType, numeric value, unit (what the committed ESP32 firmware sends). Generic shape: a non-blank capabilityKey and any non-null value, type-checked later against the capability. contractVersion and requires are optional; unknown fields are ignored and counted, never interpreted.
x-nexus-rules: device-equality: the topic device id must equal the payload deviceId (layer 3, TOPIC_DEVICE_MISMATCH)
legacy-shape: without a non-blank capabilityKey, sensorType and unit are non-blank text and value is a JSON number (INVALID_LEGACY_PAYLOAD)
code-mapping: nexus_contract.rules.classify_telemetry mirrors the order of TelemetryMQTTListener

instant.description: ISO-8601 instant. The firmware sends seconds precision ending in Z; the Python simulator sends microseconds with a +00:00 offset. Both are accepted by the backend and by this schema.
